basic_profile.bio: An avid sushi enthusiast and home cook residing in Lethbridge, Alberta. I've been exploring the culinary world through self-teaching and online resources for over a decade. My interests include experimenting with Japanese cuisine, following the latest in pro wrestling, and diving into fantasy worlds like Dragons Dogma. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me to have a flexible schedule, typically online during late evenings and weekends. I'm currently in a long-term relationship, and we both enjoy hosting sushi nights for friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep knowledge of Japanese cuisine, particularly sushi and sashimi, stemming from years of self-teaching through cookbooks and online tutorials. My expertise is also supplemented by frequent visits to Japanese specialty stores and engaging with communities on subreddits like Lethbridge and cooking threads.
